ios.desc:
Chuck is email with superpowers. Clean up thousands of emails in seconds. Swipe through batches, bulk delete, archive, and unsubscribe — all processed privately on your device.

Unlike other email apps, Chuck never reads your email content. Our on-device AI analyzes only metadata (senders, subjects, timestamps) to intelligently group and suggest what to clean up. Your emails stay on your phone, never on our servers.

ALL YOUR ACCOUNTS IN ONE PLACE
Connect Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, AOL, Microsoft 365, Fastmail, and any standard IMAP account. See all your inboxes in one unified view and clean them all at once.

AI-POWERED BATCH PROCESSING
• Swipe left or right to delete or archive hundreds of emails at once
• AI Select suggests messages you can safely remove, trained privately on your device
• Group by Sender, Subject, or Time to find and act on email in bulk
• Filter by contact, attachments, starred, unread, and more

UNSUBSCRIBE & DECLUTTER
• Unsubscribe from mailing lists with one tap
• Mark as Spam, Snooze, or Move to folders and labels
• Star, flag, and organize across all your accounts

FULL EMAIL CLIENT
Chuck isn't just a cleanup tool — it's your everyday email app. Read, reply, compose, and manage email across all your accounts with a clean, fast interface. Use it alongside Apple Mail or as your primary client.

SMART NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified about the emails that matter. Chuck learns your priorities and filters out the noise, so you only see what's important.

FREE & PRO
Use Chuck free with a generous daily email cleanup quota. Upgrade to Chuck Pro for unlimited processing, multiple accounts, AI filters, advanced sorting, custom signatures, and more.

If you're enjoying Chuck, please leave a review — it really helps! A big thank you to everyone who has left a five star review :)

About Subscription billing:
• If you choose to upgrade (optional), your iTunes account will be charged as soon as you confirm the purchase. Chuck Pro subscription is billed monthly or yearly.
• Your subscription will automatically renew after 1 month or 1 year, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• You can manage your subscription and turn-off auto-renewal by going to your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Help/Questions? Email us at support@chuck.email

quotes.text:
I have to make a correction now: I've been checking my mail and I've found that Leslie answered me but the message ended on my spam folder (hah!). The answer: They didn't have plans for the functionality I asked for. I asked for the possibility of deleting or moving certain emails after certain number of days (for example, for  newsletters, billing emails, notices, and things like that).

As of today, Mailstrom's functionality seems to be the same as 5 or more years ago. Which is not bad-bad, but not enough for me. It seems like the company is focusing on an iPhone app called Chuck [0] that's kind of similar but plus AI and some other stuff. I'll go build my own Lunar Lander.
